scripts.kill-backend: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :8000 | findstr LISTENING',{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\\n').filter(l=>l).forEach(l=>{const p=l.trim().split(/\\s+/).pop();console.log('Killing PID',p);execSync('taskkill /F /PID '+p+' /T',{encoding:'utf8'})})}catch(e){console.log('No process on port 8000')}"
scripts.dist: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
